scene.ko: 콧물과 기침에 먹을 감기약을 추천받고, 졸리지 않은지와 먹는 횟수, 빈속에 먹어도 되는지 묻는다.

lines.en: Excuse me. Could you recommend something for a cold? I have a runny nose and a cough.
lines.ko: 실례합니다. 감기약 좀 추천해 주시겠어요? 콧물이 나고 기침을 해요.
alt: Hi. What do you have for a cold? I've got a runny nose and a cough.
Excuse me. I have a runny nose and a cough. What should I take?

lines.en: This one is good for both. It comes in a day version and a night version.
lines.ko: 이게 둘 다에 잘 들어요. 낮에 먹는 것과 밤에 먹는 것이 따로 있어요.

lines.en: Will it make me sleepy? I have to drive to work.
lines.ko: 먹으면 졸려요? 차를 몰고 출근해야 하거든요.
alt: Does it make you drowsy? I need to drive to work.
Will I get sleepy? I drive to work.

lines.en: The daytime one is non-drowsy, so you'll be fine. The nighttime one will help you sleep.
lines.ko: 낮에 먹는 건 졸리지 않아서 괜찮아요. 밤에 먹는 건 잠을 잘 자게 도와줘요.

lines.en: Great. How often should I take the daytime one?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 낮에 먹는 건 얼마나 자주 먹어야 해요?
alt: Good. How many times a day do I take the day one?
Okay. How often do I take it during the day?

lines.en: Every four to six hours, but no more than four doses a day.
lines.ko: 4~6시간마다 드시되, 하루에 네 번을 넘지 마세요.

lines.en: Got it. Is it okay to take it on an empty stomach?
alt: Okay. Can I take it without eating?
I see. Do I have to eat first?

lines.en: Yes, that's fine. If your symptoms last more than a week, you should see a doctor.
lines.ko: 네, 괜찮아요. 증상이 일주일 넘게 가면 병원에 가 보세요.
